name: pickup
description: Collectible entities: a Collector that touches a Pickup takes its value into its score and the Pickup disappears.

components.name: Collector
components.description: Collects Pickups it touches; score is the sum of the values collected so far.

components.name: Pickup
components.description: Can be collected; value is added to the score of the Collector that touches it. Touching means the distance between the two Positions is at most the sum of both radii.

systems.name: collect
systems.description: Adds the value of every touched Pickup to the Collector's score and removes the Pickup. A Pickup touched by several Collectors goes to the first one.
